7. A teenager placing clean paper into a recycling bin beside a neat stack of old plain paper, the bin bears only a pictorial recycling symbol, no text.
8. A Vietnamese teenager cycling with a reusable bag and bottle past a leafy neighbourhood, calm clean sustainable everyday living.
